$comment: What any good explanation of this PR says, written by a model from the PR's title, description and diff only (scripts/eval-assertions.ts). The eval grades each run against them. Delete one that is wrong; keep them stable so evals compare.

assertions.text: Says that the PR adds birthday memories: generated for named people with a birth date, shown to the owner in the three days leading up to the birthday.
Says that birthday memories are created in the existing scheduled memory-creation job in MemoryService, alongside the on-this-day memories for each user.
Says that assets are those showing the person's visible face taken on the birthday date in earlier years, newest first, capped at 25 per memory.
Says that the 25-asset budget is divided evenly across birthday years (up to 5 per year), taking the newest assets of each year.
Says that when more than 25 birthday years have assets, 25 years are chosen at random and one asset is taken from each.
Says that people born on February 29 are celebrated on February 28 in non-leap years.
Says that the memory data DTO is generalized from the on-this-day shape to include optional person id and person name, with a Birthday memory type added.
Says that creating a birthday-type memory through the API requires personId and personName in data, enforced by validation.
Does not claim that hidden people, unnamed people, or people without a birth date get birthday memories.
Does not claim that the PR adds a new database table or migration for birthday memories.
names the service that creates the memories
